## Problem or player need

What would this improve? Describe a concrete situation.

## Proposed change

Describe the behavior you would like and how it fits the game.

## Alternatives and tradeoffs

What other approaches could work? Consider controls, balance, visual style,
performance, and existing saves where relevant.

## Related work

Link related GitHub issues or docs/work-to-be-done entries, if any.
